name: Google Antigravity
where_agents_run: your machine (projects, local folders or git worktrees, optional WSL connection on Windows), driven from any browser or phone through its Remote Control web page
license: Proprietary, closed source; free tier plus paid Google AI plans
source_note: Docs-verified: official docs, changelog, launch blog and download page read; installer sizes and app shell read from the v2.18.1 downloads; not installed or run.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Gemini, Claude or GPT, switched per task

needs_you_signal.value: Desktop notification and chime; phone push

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approval card in the app or on your phone

cross_provider_delegation.value: Subagents show as cards; only its own agents

conversation_gui_view.value: Chat per session, plans shown as artifacts

real_terminal.value: Chat only; its terminal is for your own commands

usage_hud.value: Weekly and five-hour quota left, per model family

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Through GitHub's MCP server; no built-in issue-to-PR flow

worktree_management.value: Optional new git worktree per conversation

planner_orchestrator.value: Splits work into subagents; team mode in preview

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Preview team mode, through shared artifacts

knowledge_base.value: Rules, skills and documents; no searchable notes

native_mobile_app.value: None; a web page you can add to the home screen

phone_no_new_app.value: Remote Control page in any phone browser

remote_ssh.value: Command-line version over SSH; not the desktop app

voice_input.value: Built-in dictation that strips filler words

os.value: Windows, macOS, Linux; phone or browser via web page

background_process.value: Optional: remote-access service and helper processes

runs_in_terminal.value: Own app window; its CLI is a separate tool

extensibility.value: Plugin marketplace, hooks, Python SDK in preview

teams_multiuser.value: Company sign-in and admin; no shared workspaces

stability_maturity.value: Version 2.18; 2.0 launched May 2026; parts in preview
